respuesta.pregunta: In order-workflow-api 5.6.2-hotfix-1, when a hotfix branch gets merged into master under the gitflow workflow, which branches does it get backported to, and is the backport restricted to branches with active pull requests?
respuesta.respuesta:
In the gitflow Workflow object, a backport rule fires when the base branch matches `^master$` and the head branch matches `^hotfix/.*$`. That rule backports to two targets [order-workflow-api/5.6.2-hotfix-1/guide/services/database.md:L92-L106]:

- `^develop$`, with `only_active_pull_requests: false`, so the backport to develop is not limited to active pull requests [order-workflow-api/5.6.2-hotfix-1/guide/services/database.md:L97-L100].
- `^release/.*`, with `only_active_pull_requests: true`, so release branches get the backport only when they have active pull requests [order-workflow-api/5.6.2-hotfix-1/guide/services/database.md:L101-L104].

Merges of `^release/.*$` and `^migration/.*$` branches into master follow the same backport targets with the same flags [order-workflow-api/5.6.2-hotfix-1/guide/services/database.md:L107-L134].

States that a hotfix merged into master is backported to develop and to release/* branches.
Indicates that only_active_pull_requests is false for develop and true for release/* branches.
